meta_description:
themoneylancer on October 7, 2026: "Agar tum next year ₹20 lakh ki petrol car lene wale ho, WAIT.

Because 2027 se car companies ke paas EVs aur hybrids ko push karne ka ek bada reason hoga.

It’s because of a new rule called CAFE-III.

Basically, every carmaker has to reduce the average fuel consumption of its entire fleet.

But here’s where it gets interesting.

Ek normal petrol car sell hui? Normal count.

Ek EV? CAFE calculation mein 3X weightage.

Strong hybrid? Around 1.6X.

Ab imagine karo tum Toyota, Tata, Mahindra ya Hyundai ho.

Tum kaunsi car zyada push karoge?

Woh petrol SUV jo tumhara target meet karna harder banaye…

ya EV/hybrid jo target achieve karne mein help kare?

And THAT is where buyers need to pay attention.

More launches, better offers aur financing ka equation change ho sakta hai.

Isliye next year sirf car ka price mat dekho.

Petrol, hybrid aur EV ka 5-year total cost compare karo.

Because jo car aaj cheaper lag rahi hai, zaroori nahi woh own karne mein bhi cheaper ho.

Comment CARS for the detailed changes

[car, tax, purchase, ev, new car, luxury car, petrol]

#cars #petrol #newcar #finance #money".
